title: Non-participatie bij vormingsgroepen 1972
contributors: Nederlands centrum voor volksontwikkeling * Amersfoort (data collector)
descriptions: A number of social psychological variables has been measured power and emotional assertiveness, affiliation, fear of negative evaluation, self-esteem, self-defence, social distress and social avoidance, the self-concept ( semantic differential ), value statements, a number of participation and evaluation scores by teachers and respondent / sociometric data.Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ education/ organizational membership
